title: Chapter 7 Means Test Calculation
notes: The § 707(b)(2) calculation (issue #102): every computed line is a projection of the means-test engine (core/means_test.py), the entered lines come from the case's means_test_input, and the statutory figures the 04/25 revision prints ($10,275 / $17,150 / $214.58) are code/dollar-amounts figures — both cadences pinned per effective-dating.md. Known defects, verified by widget geometry: most of the right-margin 'copy here' boxes carry no widgets (lines 3, 25, 33e, 34, 36, 38, 39c, 39d, 41b), line 39b has no widget at all, three shared widgets each fill two printed boxes (line 4 = 39a, line 9b's total = 33a, lines 13b/13e's totals = 33b/33c), and nearly every amount box on pages 5-9 is named undefined_NN — the geometry, not the name, is the identity.
